name: How long does a typical drywall hole repair take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drywall hole repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for a drywall hole repair depends on the size and complexity of the damage. A small hole might take a few hours to patch, sand, and prime. However, this often involves multiple coats of spackle or joint compound, each requiring drying time. Larger repairs, or those involving stud work, can take one to two days, including proper drying and finishing. Our team strives for efficient service while ensuring a high-quality, durable repair.
acceptedAnswer.description: Repair time varies; small holes may take a few hours across multiple stages, while larger repairs can take one to two days including drying time.
